# The multi-year roadmap

> **This is a projection of the technology register, not an independent plan.** It changes when
> the register changes, which is what stops it describing the year it was written. Every arrival
> band comes from a forecast that declares its `basis` — `evidence_based`, `extrapolated` or
> `speculative` — because an unlabelled forecast is indistinguishable from a measurement.

> ⚠ **A coming capability justifies waiting and re-running. It never licences claiming a result
> before the method can support it.**

## 2026H2

### MS-2026H2-FREE-BACKLOG — Clear the free backlog — every item that is startable now at zero compute cost

*science · confidence high*

Five route-level next actions cost nothing and are startable today: run the induced-proximity reach enumeration with a transcriptional-effector terminus; regenerate the junction-neoantigen predictions against the corrected exon index; state the selectivity requirement the monovalent route would have to meet; build an exposure criterion that passes its own positive control; resolve the primary citation for the only ex-vivo EMC evidence in the repository. ⭐ Four of these were sitting on a literature WATCH LIST as things to wait for, where they were invisible. They are work, not waiting.

**Unblocks:** `RT-TCIP`, `RT-JUNCTION-NEOANTIGEN`, `RT-MONOVALENT`, `RT-COVALENT-PROBE`, `RT-CARFILZOMIB`

### MS-2026H2-DECISION — Resolve the one blocker that costs a conversation rather than a capability

*decision · confidence high*

The program's only binary selectivity known-answer control is built, staged and has never been run. Nothing failed and nothing is missing — it is waiting on a person. It is the cheapest open blocker in the register and it gates whether the program's central quantitative claim is measurable at all. Registered as BLK-SELECTIVITY-CONTROL-UNAUTHORIZED, a kind that had no members until the taxonomy was built.

**Unblocks:** `RT-DEGRADER`, `R7`

### MS-2026H2-PUBLISH-UNBLOCKED — Publish the three deliverables that no blocker holds down

*science · confidence high*

The methods paper on the program's own failure record has NO scientific blocker at all — it is finished when the writing stops, and it is the portfolio's floor: the outcome that holds even if every family fails. The junction-oligonucleotide arc is computationally complete with delivery named honestly as its gate. The replication-stress assessment is complete on its own axis with its class-inheritance limit stated inside it. ⚠ Publishing is also the mechanism that recruits the collaborator every wet-lab-gated row depends on, so it is not a parallel track — it is the unblocking step for fourteen other rows.

**Unblocks:** `RT-METHODS-PAPER`, `RT-ASO`, `RT-ATR-ASSESS`

### MS-2026H2-SCAN-GAPS — Close the five technology dependencies nothing is scanning for

*capability · confidence high*

Five registered dependencies have no literature query, so they could land without anyone noticing — which makes their forecasts unfalsifiable in practice. Adding a query to the scan registry is free. The generated technology view flags them on every render until they are closed.

## 2027

### MS-2027-STRUCTURE — Structure prediction reaches induced-complex ASSEMBLY

*technology · confidence moderate*

The highest-fan-out capability with an `evidence_based` forecast. One arm has already landed — high inter-chain accuracy WHEN BOTH SITES ARE GIVEN — so what is expected here is assembly from sequence and ligand alone, plus the benchmark discipline of reporting inter-chain rather than per-chain accuracy on post-training-horizon structures. ⚠ In-horizon results are memorisation-permitting by construction and move nothing.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-COFOLD-ASSEMBLY`, `BLK-TERNARY-GEOMETRY`, `BLK-INDUCED-COMPLEX`, `RT-DEGRADER`, `RT-ANDGATE`, `RT-TCIP`, `RT-RIPTAC`

### MS-2027-ENSEMBLE-CALIBRATION — Cheap conformational ensembles become calibrated, not merely available

*technology · confidence moderate*

The detection arm landed in 2026 and is already in production use here. What is expected is calibration on rare-open populations — which is what would turn a qualitative cross-check into a population estimate, and what decides whether a proteome-scale cryptic-pocket survey is feasible.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-CHEAP-ENSEMBLE`, `R1`, `R2`, `R6`

### MS-2027-AGENTS — Autonomous research agents hold a multi-month thread with acceptable provenance

*AI capability · confidence moderate*

Partly landed already: agents run this repository's compute lanes, monitoring and document generation. The gap is durability and judgement over months, not raw capability — and this repository has direct evidence of that gap, because a scheduled agent task credited in two of its own documents has never produced an entry. ⭐ This is one of the few dependencies observable from inside rather than inferred from literature, which makes its forecast unusually checkable.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-AUTONOMOUS-AGENT`

## 2028

### MS-2028-FREE-ENERGY — A free-energy method validated on cryptic and induced-fit pockets

*technology · confidence low*

⭐ The single highest-fan-out dependency in the portfolio, and the one that decides whether the program's central quantitative claim is ever measurable. Until it lands, every absolute free-energy number on the binder path is uninterpretable — the engine misses a known answer by more than the entire margin it is asked to resolve, and that is an ACCURACY problem, not a scale one, so more compute does not substitute.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-FE-CRYPTIC-POCKET`, `BLK-PARALOGUE-DDG`, `R7`, `RT-DEGRADER`, `RT-MONOVALENT`, `RT-GLUE`, `RT-RIPTAC`, `RT-TCIP`

### MS-2028-VIRTUAL-CELL — Perturbation models predict held-out phenotype in an untrained cell type

*AI capability · confidence low*

The route by which EMC's data poverty stops being binding without any EMC data being generated: a model that generalises to an untrained cell type could ask the fusion-dependence question — the make-or-break premise beneath the degrader and the oligonucleotide routes alike — which this program currently delegates entirely. ⚠ This is where defaulting to conservative assumptions bites hardest; foundation-model progress in adjacent domains has repeatedly outrun conservative forecasts, and the expected band reflects that deliberately.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-VIRTUAL-CELL`, `BLK-NO-EMC-DATA`, `BLK-CLASS-INHERITANCE`, `R16`

### MS-2028-REGRADE — Re-grade completed work against the capability level of the day

*science · confidence high*

A completed result is a snapshot at a capability level, not a permanent fact. This is a standing milestone rather than a task: when a dependency lands, the work it touches is re-run rather than merely cited. ⚠ Guardrail, unchanged: a coming capability justifies waiting and re-running — it never licences claiming the result before the method can support it.

**Depends on:** MS-2027-STRUCTURE, MS-2027-ENSEMBLE-CALIBRATION, MS-2028-FREE-ENERGY

## 2029

### MS-2029-ACCESS — Bench access becomes reachable — by collaborator or by robot

*lab capability · confidence low*

⭐ The milestone that would flip the program's FOUNDING CONSTRAINT — that no wet lab is available, so every step must be in-silico or publish-to-convince. Fourteen routes are held by the access blocker, more than any other. Two independent paths: a self-interested collaborator (which a convincing preprint is what buys), or a cloud lab reaching solo-affordable pricing with the right assay scope. ⚠ They are NOT interchangeable — a cloud lab supplies robots and generic reagents, never the EMC cell line, so it flips the execution gate and not automatically the material gate.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-EMC-MODEL-ACCESS`, `TECH-CLOUD-WET-LAB`, `BLK-NO-WET-LAB`, `BLK-R4-BINDS`, `BLK-FUNCTIONAL-ACTIONABILITY`, `R4`

### MS-2029-EMC-DATA — Public EMC functional-genomics or expression data exists

*data · confidence low*

The repository-wide rate-limiter, holding fifteen routes — more than any method blocker. It is a DATA dependency, not a method one, and it is the least controllable item on this roadmap: it depends on a group collecting a series and choosing to deposit it. Nine routes re-grade automatically when it lands, which is why the model records them explicitly rather than leaving the fan-out to be re-derived.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-EMC-EXPRESSION-DATA`, `BLK-NO-EMC-DATA`

### MS-2029-DELIVERY — An oligonucleotide delivery route to a non-hepatic solid tumour

*technology · confidence low*

The one remaining gate on the most structurally sound route in the portfolio — the only genuinely fusion-selective one. ⭐ The higher-value observation is not a delivery platform but a characterised EMC-enriched surface antigen to serve as a targeting arm: with one, existing conjugate chemistry may suffice. That is a discovery event rather than an engineering one and could happen at any time, which is why the optimistic band is much earlier than the expected one.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-OLIGO-DELIVERY`, `BLK-DELIVERY`, `RT-ASO`, `RT-ASO-ASK`

## 2030+

### MS-2030-VECTOR — Solid-tumour vector delivery at therapeutic coverage

*technology · confidence low*

The slowest delivery problem and the one three genetic routes wait on. Kept strictly separate from oligonucleotide delivery: different engineering problems with different candidate solutions, and merging them would let one arriving imply the other had.

**Unblocks:** `TECH-VECTOR-DELIVERY`, `BLK-VECTOR-DELIVERY`, `RT-CRISPR-CAS13`, `RT-RIBOZYME`, `RT-SYNPROMOTER`

## Standing

### MS-STANDING-REPRIORITISE — Standing: re-run the priority ordering whenever a dependency changes state

*process · confidence high*

This roadmap is a projection of the technology register, not an independent plan — so it changes when the register does, and a landed capability re-orders the portfolio automatically rather than by anyone remembering to. ⚠ Every forecast carries `last_reviewed`, and one older than two quarters is flagged rather than silently trusted. A roadmap nobody re-grades is a roadmap that describes the year it was written.
